column1: Motion: Change in Coordinates of an object with time.
Velocity:  It is speed, but used when referencing 2 objects, or 2 forces, or 2 time interval, or 2 distances.
Acceleration: When velocity increase, rate of change of Velocity is called acceleration
Retardation: When velocity decrease, rate of change of Velocity is called retardation
Angular velocity: Degree change per unit of time. 1 revolution is equal to 360°
